paidOutFormula: revenue 89,463 − operating cash flow 1,065 + capex 2,942 (USD millions, as stated)
notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (FY2025 Form 10-K, accession 0001628280-26-004357). Operating cash flow was small (1,065) after a further inventory build (1,501) and lower advances (−723), so paidOut (91.34bn) slightly exceeds revenue. The $9,672 million gain on dispositions (mainly the Digital Aviation Solutions divestiture) is not in revenue and is backed out of operating cash flow as a non-cash item; the $10,585 million proceeds are investing and excluded, as are acquisitions (1,248, net of cash; the Spirit AeroSystems acquisition was paid mainly in shares) and supplier notes receivable (662).
